candidate_evidence.quote: Patients will receive sonodynamic therapy (5 ALA combined with CV01-delivered sonication) 2 to 5 days prior to standard resection.
This trial is designed to evaluate safety and explore possible efficacy of 5-aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients With Newly Diagnosed High-Grade Glioma (HGG) Prior to Resection and Standard Adjuvant Therapy

role_evidence.quote: Patients will receive sonodynamic therapy (5 ALA combined with CV01-delivered sonication) 2 to 5 days prior to standard resection.

agents.drug_class_hint: sonosensitiser (protoporphyrin IX precursor) for sonodynamic therapy

coder_notes: 5-ALA is tested here for antitumour sonodynamic therapy (explore possible efficacy, histopathological anti-tumour activity outcome), so a device-dependent candidate rather than a diagnostic agent. Standard resection and radio-/chemotherapy follow the study intervention and are not part of the experimental arm. The CV01 ultrasound device is not listed as an agent.
